rationale: The agent authenticated the user by name and ZIP and looked up orders, but then executed a return (return_delivered_order_items on order #W1679211) without first confirming the action with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm any order-changing write. The user asked to “return everything but a tablet” and to know how much they would get back; the conversation shows no confirmation of which order was the “recently delivered” one, no confirmation of the specific items to be returned, and no calculation or presentation of the refund amount. The final message is a generic closing, providing no requested outcome details. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
